title: Animatronic Intern (Spring 2027) – Surface/Integration Designer
note: Animatronics studio internship designing exterior skins and surfaces in 3D; the title says Spring 2027 though the body text mentions Fall, so confirm timing when applying.

facts.summary: Paid internship at an animatronics and themed-entertainment fabricator, designing the outer surfaces of animatronic figures.
facts.duties: Model exterior surfaces in 2D/3D, design how composite skins fit with structures, mechanisms and soft goods, and deliver print- or machine-ready 3D files to production while coordinating with mechanical and production teams.
facts.requirements: Background in product design and 3D modeling; tools like SolidWorks, Rhino, ZBrush and Photoshop; understanding of mesh vs. solid modeling.
facts.apply: Apply online through LF Studios' careers posting.
